related.title: Safetensors 模型交付：分塊續傳與完整性
related.titleEn: Safetensors delivery: chunked resume and integrity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：平均按時間加權，熱限制證據明確，未以停用保護換取分數。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Average is time-weighted, diagnostic evidence is explicit, and protection stays enabled.
related.difference: 區分格式安全、檔案完整性、來源可信與使用授權，不將檔名或雜湊當成全部信任。
related.differenceEn: Separate format safety, integrity, provenance and authorization rather than trusting filenames or hashes alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 總工作=Σrate_i×time_i；平均速率=總工作/總時間，不能平均不同長度區段而不加權。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 前20 s為100工作/s，後40 s為70工作/s，總60 s；速率是合成量。 總工作20×100+40×70=4800，平均80工作/s。
固定分塊傳輸只重送缺少或校驗失敗的塊；完整檔雜湊需在重組後再次核對。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學模型8192 MiB，塊64 MiB，共128塊，連線有效速率32 MiB/s，忽略協定開銷。 全量理想時間8192/32=256 s；雜湊計算及伺服器確認另計。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Total work=Σrate×time; average rate is total work/time, not an unweighted mean of unequal intervals. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. First20 s at 100 work units/s, next40 s at 70, total 60 s; all rates synthetic. Work4800, mean 80 units/s.

Fixed-chunk resume retransmits missing/corrupt chunks; the reconstructed whole-file digest is checked again. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching model8192 MiB, 64 MiB chunks, 128 chunks, effective32 MiB/s, excluding protocol overhead. Full ideal transfer256 s, with hashing and server confirmation additional.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ShuffleNet：群組卷積與通道洗牌
related.titleEn: ShuffleNet: grouped convolution and channel shuffle
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：平均按時間加權，熱限制證據明確，未以停用保護換取分數。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Average is time-weighted, diagnostic evidence is explicit, and protection stays enabled.
related.difference: 將0..23寫成3×8表，轉置成8×3再攤平；畫相鄰群組如何交換來源。；192與96計數正確，排列雙射且逆運算逐項相同。
related.differenceEn: Arrange0..23 as3×8, transpose to8×3 and flatten; trace how groups exchange input origins.; Counts192 and96 match; the permutation is bijective and its inverse restores every entry.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 總工作=Σrate_i×time_i；平均速率=總工作/總時間，不能平均不同長度區段而不加權。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 前20 s為100工作/s，後40 s為70工作/s，總60 s；速率是合成量。 總工作20×100+40×70=4800，平均80工作/s。
等大小群組的1×1成本為CinCout/g；洗牌是排列，不增加可訓練參數。；教學Cin=Cout=24，g=3，與g=6比較。；MAC=24×24/3=192；g=6為96。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Total work=Σrate×time; average rate is total work/time, not an unweighted mean of unequal intervals. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. First20 s at 100 work units/s, next40 s at 70, total 60 s; all rates synthetic. Work4800, mean 80 units/s.
Equal-sized pointwise groups cost CinCout/g MACs; shuffle is a permutation with no trainable parameters.; Teaching Cin=Cout=24, comparing g=3 and g=6.; MAC=24×24/3=192; g=6 gives96.
